## Count outcomes

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="60%"}
- What is a count variable?
  - Discrete
  - Values of zero or above
  - A summation of yes/no choices/outcomes
- E.g., Number of alcoholic drinks consumed last week; \# of days attending religious services last month; \# of protests attended in life; \# of functional limitation; \# of academic citations received
  - \# of [Prussian army deaths by horse kick (per year)](https://mindyourdecisions.com/blog/2013/06/21/what-do-deaths-from-horse-kicks-have-to-do-with-statistics/)
:::
